authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly marks Hindi ṭhaṇḍā as the source of Punjabi and several West Pahari cold forms. The existing Hindi comparandum is therefore used as the immediate donor for this northwestern survey form, with local transmission provisional where the exact survey variety is not named. Ordinary final agreement is retained, and the -ha extended Kullu response is excluded.
